description: Ordering on a writable copy of the query fixture: QOrdA and QOrdB are created with the same expressions but reversed parameter, projected-field and sort-term order. Asks for each QueryDef's Parameters and Fields (Name, Type) and their MSysQueries rows; then QOrdA is deleted and recreated with identical SQL and its rows are read again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
